name: herdr-agent-org-grok
description: Grok agent-org on Herdr substrate. Orchestrator/herdr-worker/replacer/org-audit skills + filesystem board CLI. Dispatches workers via herdr agent start in real panes; coordination over the org-relay MCP bus (durable queue + in-turn relay_await + the 0.5.0 nudge watchdog ringing recipients whose queued messages have no listener), herdr agent wait as fallback, org-waker demoted to legacy; no Solo MCP required. The orchestrator self-plans (L3): no planner agent exists in this org. L16 makes lane trees MCP-first (skyline_workspace_create with an absolute from_path, CLI skyrift second, git worktree last) and L17 makes dispatch effort explicit, with dispatch-worker appending --effort medium for grok and refusing an upgrade without --upgrade-reason (marketplace#32). Session discipline hooks (lane mark, conduct refresh, stop gate) use exact ${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT} load-time paths. Requires HERDR_ENV=1 and herdr >= 0.7.
